component.name: TVGuide

Label.text: OK: play shuffled channel Right: browse all programs

component.script:
sub init() m.channelGrid = m.top.findNode("channelGrid") m.guideBackdrop = m.top.findNode("guideBackdrop") m.guideBackdrop.opacity = manifestOpacity("guide_backdrop_opacity", 0.25) m.top.findNode("guideForeground").opacity = manifestOpacity("guide_foreground_opacity", 1.0) m.bgVideo = m.top.findNode("bgVideo") m.bgImage = m.top.findNode("bgImage") m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "focusGuide") m.top.observeField("visible", "onVisibilityChanged") m.channelGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onItemSelected") m.channelGrid.observeField("itemFocused", "onItemFocused") m.focusedIndex = 0 initBackground() end sub
sub initBackground() bgVideoUrl = manifestString("ondemand_background_video") bgImageUrl = manifestString("ondemand_background_image") bgOpacity = manifestOpacity("background_video_opacity", 0.25) m.bgVideoActive = false m.bgImageActive = false if bgVideoUrl <> "" m.bgVideo.opacity = bgOpacity content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = bgVideoUrl content.streamFormat = bgStreamFormat(bgVideoUrl) content.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" m.bgVideo.content = content m.bgVideoActive = true if m.top.visible m.bgVideo.visible = true m.bgVideo.control = "play" end if else if bgImageUrl <> "" m.bgImage.opacity = bgOpacity m.bgImage.uri = bgImageUrl m.bgImageActive = true if m.top.visible then m.bgImage.visible = true end if end sub
sub onVisibilityChanged() if m.bgVideoActive if m.top.visible m.bgVideo.visible = true m.bgVideo.control = "play" else m.bgVideo.control = "stop" m.bgVideo.visible = false end if else if m.bgImageActive m.bgImage.visible = m.top.visible end if end sub
sub onContentChanged() m.channelGrid.content = m.top.content updateBackdrop(0) end sub
sub onItemSelected(event as object) m.top.channelSelected = gridIndex(event.getData()) end sub
sub onItemFocused(event as object) m.focusedIndex = gridIndex(event.getData()) updateBackdrop(m.focusedIndex) end sub
sub updateBackdrop(index as integer) if m.top.content = invalid or index < 0 or index >= m.top.content.getChildCount() m.guideBackdrop.visible = false m.guideBackdrop.uri = "" return end if item = m.top.content.getChild(index) if item = invalid or item.HDPosterUrl = "" m.guideBackdrop.visible = false m.guideBackdrop.uri = "" return end if m.guideBackdrop.uri = item.HDPosterUrl m.guideBackdrop.visible = true end sub
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
function manifestString(key as string) as string appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid then return "" return text.trim() end function
function bgStreamFormat(url as string) as string lowered = LCase(url) if instr(1, lowered, ".m3u8") > 0 then return "hls" if instr(1, lowered, ".mpd") > 0 then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
sub focusGuide() m.channelGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
function gridIndex(position as dynamic) as integer if type(position) = "roArray" return position[0] * m.channelGrid.numColumns + position[1] end if return position end function
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "left" m.top.menuRequested = true return true end if if key <> "right" then return false if m.top.content = invalid or m.top.content.getChildCount() = 0 then return false m.top.channelBrowseRequested = m.focusedIndex return true end function
